title.narrative: EU Twinning Migration Agency Azerbaijan phase 1b

description.narrative: Målet med Sidas insats är att Migrationsverket skall kunna lämna ett kvalitativt förslag till projektgenomförande av det azerbaijanska projektet Support to further improvement of the migration management system in Azerbaijan. För att kunna utarbeta projektförslaget krävs att Migrationsverket har full kostnadstäckning i processen kring framtagande av projektförslag Migrationsverket kommer att slutrapportera och fakturera i enlighet med havda kostnader för aktiviteter relaterade till arbetet med projektförslaget. Projektet i Azerbaijan bidrar till att uppnå ett antal av de globala hållbarhetsmålen, framförallt SDG 10 (Reduced inequality), men relaterar också till SDG 3 (Good health and well-being), SDG 5 (Gender equality), SDG 8 (Decent job and economic growth), SDG 16 (Peace, justice and strong institutions) och SDG 17 (Partnerships for the goals).

The goal of Sida's contribution is for the Swedish Migration Agency to be able to submit a proposal for project implementation of the Azerbaijani project "Support to further improvement of the migration management system in Azerbaijan". In order to prepare the project proposal, it is necessary that the Migration Agency has full cost coverage in this process. The Migration Agency will make a final report and invoice in accordance with costs incurred for activities related to the work with the project proposal. The project in Azerbaijan contributes to achieving a number of the UN sustainable development goals, above all SDG 10 (Reduced inequality), but also relates to SDG 3 (Good health and well-being), SDG 5 (Gender equality), SDG 8 (Decent job and economic growth), SDG 16 (Peace, justice and strong institutions) and SDG 17 (Partnerships for the goals).
